title: Multiple items arriving broken or defective
situation: Customers are receiving damaged or defective items that require immediate replacements or refunds before chargebacks escalate.

params.reply_en: We are sorry your item arrived damaged. We have processed a free replacement for you, which will ship out shortly.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر لتوصيل المنتج تالفاً. لقد قمنا بترتيب شحنة بديلة جديدة لك وسيتم إرسالها قريباً.

actions.why: Acknowledge the damage and inform customers about the replacement.
Send a replacement for the broken items.
Track the defective batch for logistics reporting.
